tmp:1957: nemalah — the ant of Proverbs 6:6 ('go to the ant, sluggard'), symbol of the sage who teaches wisdom and God's ways to the people
tmp:1960: nimtak ha-din — the sweetening/mitigation of a judgment, effected by moving from mochin de-katnut to mochin de-gadlut (Chokhmah)
tmp:1961: making a beautiful garment for the tzaddik — the act of clothing the tzaddik finely, which serves to sweeten judgments
tmp:1962: nimtak ha-dinim — the sweetening of the judgments (plural dinim), the effect produced by making a fine garment for the tzaddik
tmp:1963: sweetening the din and charon af — mitigating judgment and divine wrath via the all-inclusive pidyon (redemption) at the eit ratzon of the 24 courts
tmp:1964: sweetening of the idolatrous nations so they become converts (gerim) — transformation of gentiles through the sweetening of judgments
tmp:1965: holy fervor/enthusiasm (hitlahavut she-bikdushah) — sacred ecstatic ardor termed 'the wine that gladdens' (yayin ha-mesameach)
tmp:1966: nimtakim ha-gevurot/behorot — the sweetening of the harsh judgments (twice Elokim = ekev) at the heels through dancing, expelling the chitzonim
tmp:1967: nimtakim kol ha-dinim — the sweetening of all judgments, achieved when Torah draws from supernal Chokhmah (even shetiyah, Holy of Holies)
tmp:1968: nisayon — the trial/test of free choice, located together with the scale (matkela) and bechirah in kelipat nogah
tmp:1970: tehomot — the subterranean depths/abysses from which the Land of Israel drinks, an aspect of miracles (nissim, per 'vatehom kol ha-ir')
tmp:1971: tehoma tata'ah — the 'lower depth' (Zoharic term), the abyss corresponding to lower miracles (nissim tata'in)
tmp:1972: nissim tata'in — 'lower miracles,' miracles clothed in nature, corresponding to the lower depth (tehoma tata'ah) that waters the Land of Israel
tmp:1973: tze ('Depart!') — the word addressed to idolatry in Isaiah 30:22, expounded as the aspect of journeying and displacement
tmp:1974: nesiah ve-tiltul — journeying and wandering/displacement, the exile-travel state signified by 'tze' said to idols
tmp:1977: NA'AR (נע"ר = 320) — gematria equivalent of ShaKh (320), the five-times-Elokim judgments of the bride/Malkhut before receiving the heart's alephs
tmp:1978: ne'im zemirot Yisrael — 'sweet singer of Israel' (II Samuel 23), epithet of King David, the melodic aspect of Malkhut of David
tmp:1979: hishtalshelut ha-gevurot as external fear — the downward chaining of the gevurot manifesting as outward/worldly fear (yirah chitzonit)
tmp:1980: planting the reed in the sea of Chokhmah — Gabriel's na'atz kaneh ba-yam read as external gevurot-fear fixing the voice (kol from the kaneh) in wisdom
tmp:1982: 've-ha-niglot lanu u-levaneinu' (Deut 29:28) — 'the revealed things are for us and our children,' identified with na'aseh ('we will do')
tmp:1985: explaining the matter in a language one understands — the tzaddik's act of translating Torah into the hearer's own tongue/level
tmp:1986: na'aseh bi-vchinat chal — becoming 'profaned/wounded' (chal, from mecholal mi-peshaeinu), the tzaddik-Mashiach's state of bearing Israel's sufferings
tmp:1987: shimush ha-chakham — serving/attending the Torah sage, the apprenticeship-service by which one becomes 'flesh' to the sage
tmp:1988: becoming the aspect of flesh (basar) to the sage — the transformation of the attendant into the sage's own flesh through service
tmp:1989: awakening people from their sleep by telling stories — the tzaddik's rousing of spiritually asleep souls via sipurei ma'asiyot ('ve-alehu li-terufah')
tmp:1990: shaping the letters for good — configuring the letter-combinations (tziruf otiyot) toward good so the prayer-request is fulfilled
tmp:1992: making Da'at, i.e., Torah — producing knowledge/Torah ('mah') out of the double concealment (hastarah she-betokh hastarah, Esther/haster astir)
tmp:1993: the body serving the soul through performing practical mitzvot — physical mitzvah-action as the body's shimush of the neshamah
tmp:1994: the body becoming 'flesh' (basar) to the soul — the state attained when the body serves the soul, completing Jerusalem (mevaser)
tmp:1995: na'aseh ha-dibur — the formation/creation of speech, effected through charity which rests on trust (bitachon) rooted in intellect
tmp:1996: ratzon as kisufin — the will identified with holy yearnings/longings, which forms the soul in potential
tmp:1997: the soul made in potential (nefesh be-koach) — the soul's potential state created by yearning/will, awaiting actualization through speech
tmp:1998: expressing one's desire aloud with the mouth — vocalizing the heart's longing, which actualizes the soul from potential
tmp:1999: the soul made actual (nefesh be-fo'al) — the actualization of the potential soul through spoken utterance ('nafshi yatzah be-dabro')
tmp:2000: the mouth/speech made through charity — formation of the peh (dibur), man's defining trait ('na'aseh adam'), via tzedakah
tmp:2001: God becoming, as it were, in the aspect of a woman — the divine 'feminine' state of receiving delight when Israel fulfills His desire for their prayer
tmp:2002: forming the speech of confession from them — transforming the sin-combinations engraved on one's bones into the words of vidui (verbal confession)
tmp:2003: na'aseh moftim u-fla'ot — wonders and marvels being wrought (new heavens and earth) through praise spoken with strength eaten via Eretz Yisrael's shefa of truth
tmp:2004: hishtokekut ba-lev — yearning/longing in the heart, which creates the soul and vowel-points in potential but requires verbal expression
tmp:2005: nefesh u-nekudot be-koach — the soul and vowel points formed in potential by heart-yearning, prior to actualization through speech
